# truenas_cloudsync_credentials (Resource)

Manages TrueNAS cloud sync credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_cloudsync_credentials" "backup_s3" {
  name = "backup-s3"
  provider_config = jsonencode({
    type              = "S3"
    access_key_id     = "AKIA..."
    secret_access_key = "..."
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the cloud sync credentials.
- `provider_config` (String, Sensitive) JSON document of provider settings. Must include "type" (e.g. S3, B2, GOOGLE_CLOUD_STORAGE, STORJ_IX).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric cloud sync credentials ID assigned by TrueNAS.
